title: Exact Tangent of pi over Three
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Compute $\tan\left(\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)$ exactly by dividing the known sine and cosine values for this angle.

steps.title: Recall the Component Values
steps.explanation: The $30^{\circ}$-$60^{\circ}$-$90^{\circ}$ triangle supplies both special-angle values.
steps.why: Tangent can be built from sine and cosine of the same angle.

steps.title: Form the Quotient
steps.explanation: Divide the sine value by the cosine value using the identity $\tan\\theta=\\sin\\theta/\\cos\\theta$.
steps.why: The denominator $\cos(\pi/3)=1/2$ is nonzero, so the quotient identity applies.

steps.title: Simplify the Complex Fraction
steps.explanation: Multiplying by the reciprocal of $1/2$ cancels the twos and leaves $\sqrt{3}$.
steps.why: Clearing nested fractions yields the exact final value.
